answer.summary: Both 1400px toolbar layout tests failed the same way: the 'Go to next page' pagination button was never found, so toBeInViewport timed out after 15s. The branch changes the list toolbar and PaginationComponentV2.tsx, and the failure is deterministic with zero flake history, so it most likely comes from this change. The log has no stack trace or screenshot content, so confidence is moderate.
